παρα-δια-τριβή, -ῆς, ἡ
useless wrangling: seel. in Rec. for διαπαρατριβή (which see), 1Ti.6:5.†
δια-παρα-τριβή, -ῆς, ἡ
(παρατριβή, friction, irritation)
mutual irritation (Field, Notes, 211), wrangling: 1Ti.6:5 (Rec. παραδιατριβή).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.
